name: DSC IT-100 Integration Module
description: Integrates DSC IT-100 alarm panels with OpenAegis.
author: Santiago Gutierrez

connectionSetupSteps.step: Connect the IT-100 module to your server via USB.
connectionSetupSteps.details: Ensure the device is recognized and note the serial port (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0).
Set the baud rate to one of the following options (default: 9600):

connectionSetupSteps.step: Provide the code you would like to use to arm/disarm the system from OpenAegis.
connectionSetupSteps.details: This code will be used for arm/disarm commands sent from OpenAegis. Make sure to use a valid user code that has the necessary permissions on your DSC panel.
The plugin will attempt to connect to the IT-100 module using the provided settings.
